newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV WIN DUTCH SUPER CUP WITH LATE GOALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV WIN DUTCH SUPER CUP WITH LATE GOALS.

text.p: League champions PSV Eindhoven won the Dutch Super Cup for the second year in a row with two goals in injury time to beat Cup winners Roda JC Kerkrade 3-1 on Sunday.
In the traditional opening to the Dutch soccer season Philip Cocu opened the score for PSV in the 22nd minute with a hard, low shot from just outside the box.

Roda, clearly missing last season's topscorer Gerald Sibon who was transferred to Ajax Amsterdam during the close season, struggled to find the equaliser, but finally Belgian striker Peter van Houdt found the net with only six minutes remaining.
But two minutes into extra time PSV regained the lead when Cocu scored from a cross by Boudewijn Zenden cross.
Belgian international Gilles de Bilde made victory certain immediately afterwards by hitting home PSV's third goal.
The Dutch league starts on Tuesday.
